analysis.one_line_summary: Creator tests the Wavytalk steam hair straightening brush on her 3C curly hair, showing the step-by-step process and achieving sleek straight results in 17 minutes.
analysis.full_description: A curly-haired creator tests the Wavytalk steam straightening brush (Steambrush Pro) to see if steam can straighten her 3C curly hair. She unboxes the accessories (scrunchie, salon hair clips, heat glove, water dropper bottle, cleaning brush), fills the water reservoir, applies heat protectant, and brushes through sections of her curls. Shocked by how straight, shiny, and frizz-free her hair becomes after just a few passes, she tracks her time on her phone stopwatch, finishing her entire head in 17 minutes, comparing the result and speed favorably against the Revlon blow-dry brush.

scenes.visual: Creator holding the pink Wavytalk steam straightening brush while showing her natural 3C curls.
scenes.action: Points to the brush and sets up the challenge of testing if steam can straighten her hair.

scenes.visual: Included accessories displayed to the camera.
scenes.action: Creator unboxes and showcases the pink scrunchie, black styling clips, heat-resistant glove, water bottle, and cleaning brush.
Creator opens the water dropper bottle and pours water into the tool's detachable reservoir.

scenes.visual: TikTok screenshots of other creators showing their straight hair results using the Wavytalk steam brush.
scenes.action: Creator references social proof that inspired her to try it.
Refills reservoir, clicks it into the brush, and points to the 410-degree indicator light.
Creator sprays Pureology heat protectant all over her hair before styling.
Creator passes the steam brush through a small curly section, revealing straight hair in disbelief.
Runs brush through section again, shows steam emitting from the vents, and displays smooth straightened section.
Creator starts phone stopwatch, puts on the black protective glove, and prepares to do her whole head.
Brushes from roots with tension, marveling at how straight and shiny the hair gets after a few strokes.
Re-sprays heat protectant and glides the brush through another bottom section.
Shows depleted water level in the transparent tank and refills it with the dropper.
At 10 minutes, shows right side completely straight versus left side still tightly curled; compares to Revlon brush.
Creator explains technique for front hair: placing brush underneath and lifting up so steam vents away from face.
Shows complete straight, glossy hairstyle, reveals 17:07 on stopwatch, touches hair to show softness, and recaps price and salon-level results.

narrative_beats: Hook: Can steam straighten 3C curly hair?
Social proof reference (seeing other TikTok results)
First pass test and immediate shock reaction
Midway comparison (half curly vs half pin straight at 10 min)
Technique and pro-tips for the forehead/roots
Final result showcase: full head completed in 17 minutes
Price vs value conclusion and link in bio callout
key_claims: Straightens 3C curly hair to pin-straight in 3 strokes
Full head styled in just 17 minutes
Delivers intense shine and silky smoothness
Combines straightening and blow-dry brush efficiency in one step
pain_points: Straightening curly hair usually takes hours
Traditional blowouts require multiple tools and steps
Risk of heat burns without proper protection or technique
objections_handled: Will steam actually work on coarse/tight 3C curls?
Is it going to burn my hands or forehead?
Does the water tank run out too quickly?
